reflow: At a width of 320 pixels every page reflows to one column with no sideways scrolling of the page. Long equations sit in their own small scroll areas, which WCAG allows for content such as math that needs two-dimensional layout. Tables reflow into labeled cards on narrow screens.
spacing: With line height 1.5, paragraph spacing 2×, letter spacing 0.12×, and word spacing 0.16× applied, no text was cut off or overlapped on the pages tested (a practice-problem page, a section with figures, a Chapter Guide with tables, and an exercise page with math).
summary: The book supports 40 of the 50 WCAG 2.1 Level A and AA criteria and partially supports 5; 5 do not apply. The automated scan of all 163 pages found no failures in the book’s own content. The partial ratings come from three sources: one video with only automatic captions; the optional lecture videos, which have no separate audio-description track (the section text teaches the same content); and the glossary pop-ups that the LibreTexts platform adds, which do not work from the keyboard. The same definitions are available in keyboard-friendly form on the Glossary page and in each Chapter Guide.
